takeaway: A fifth forecast has been scored: the Oct 23 ranking got 10 of its top 15 right, the best yet. The fastest measured riser is a public library of jailbreak prompts, up 27% in a day, while the design skills that led last week are slowing slightly.

findings.heading: Fifth forecast: best top-15 hit rate so far
findings.text: The Oct 23 ranking scored a rank correlation of 0.65 and got 67% of its top 15 right across 61 apps, against about 25% for random picks. The earlier four scored 0.55 to 0.71 with 53% to 60%.

findings.heading: The self-tuner held for a third run
findings.text: Over 5 matured days, weighing stated gains 1.0 to 0.9 raises mean rank correlation from 0.656 to 0.662, better on every day but under the +0.02 bar.

findings.heading: A jailbreak-prompt library is the fastest riser
findings.text: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks went from 7,536 to 9,549 stars in a day (+27%), after +1,553 the day before. It has 1.3k forks and 95 watchers; not judged inorganic.

findings.heading: Design skills slow slightly
findings.text: hallmark gained 1,203 stars (1,609 the day before) and ai-design-skills 1,055 (1,453); impeccable held at 2,433.

findings.heading: Agents with their own computers
findings.text: Two new entrants give each agent its own machine: milind-soni/OpenMausBot (7,696 stars, +1,199 in a day) and CopilotKit/OpenBot (8,322 stars).

findings.heading: Amazon counts Alexa for Shopping users over 12 months
findings.text: Over 400 million customers used Alexa for Shopping (formerly Rufus) in the last 12 months, a reach figure rather than monthly users. Read from search results.

caveats: Five matured forecasts are still a small sample; the tuner's bar keeps noise-sized gains from moving any setting.
Only 2 company figures could be recorded today; most Q3 disclosures were usage multiples the radar does not track.
Every re-observed repo page showed a rounded count today.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
